board-navy.purpose: The board: header, hero panels, navy sections, tags. Elementor Global Color Primary.

board-strip.purpose: Face of directory strips, step cells, channel cards. Elementor custom.

board-deep.purpose: Rail/seams, lit mount, footer, text on yellow, navy hover fill. Elementor custom.

shop-magenta.purpose: Brand 'PET SHOP' colour; light grounds only (Bangla sub-lines, note icon). Elementor Global Color Secondary.

here-yellow.purpose: The only state colour: you-are-here, filled strips, action strip, primary button, numerals, focus. Elementor Global Color Accent.

here-yellow-lit.purpose: Hover fill on yellow surfaces; focus ring on navy.

ink.purpose: Body text on light grounds. Elementor Global Color Text.

ink-muted.purpose: Secondary text on aluminium/white (7:1). Elementor custom.

aluminium-rail.purpose: Seams and rails on light grounds, dividers.

white.purpose: White sections, light list cells, white button.

display.purpose: Page H1 on the board. Elementor Global Font Primary (800).

headline.purpose: Section H2, always followed by its Bangla line.

numeral.purpose: Plate numbers (2F, 122), phone number, step numbers.

title.purpose: Step, action-strip and channel-card titles. Elementor Global Font Secondary (700).

bangla-line.purpose: Bangla sub-lines under headings; magenta on light, yellow on navy.

body.purpose: All reading text, max 68ch; 18px under 520px. Elementor Global Font Text (400).

label.purpose: Buttons and nav. Elementor Global Font Accent (700).

fontLoading.note: Elementor's loader supplies weights only; load the width axis separately.

shadows.name: lit-mount
shadows.purpose: Video panels mounted in the board.

shadows.name: plate-outline
shadows.purpose: Location plates (ghost button uses inset 0 0 0 2px currentColor).

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: All focus-visible; #ffd34d on the navy board and footer; strips use -3px offset.

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: Everything that arrives, fills or lifts.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Content leaving on page change only.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveals; 80ms sibling stagger; slats 0.12s stagger.

motion.name: duration-zoom
motion.purpose: Image hover zoom and focus-in reveal.

motion.name: duration-floor
motion.purpose: Floor line draw; stops light 0.35s apart.

motion.name: page-transition
motion.value: @view-transition { navigation: auto; } with names k-header (pinned), k-main (sink 0.26s out, rise 0.6s in after 0.12s), k-here (slide 0.6s), k-dock
motion.purpose: Cross-document View Transitions; without support, main rises in over 0.6s.

motion.name: intro-assembly
motion.value: strips slat 0.85s, 70ms stagger from 180ms; lit panel rise 1.1s at 0.3s; action strip rise 0.9s at 0.62s
motion.purpose: Home board assembles once on first view.

motion.name: reveal-classes
motion.value: k-rv (fade + 22px rise), k-rv-img (fade, scale 1.04, 6px blur clears), k-rv-slats (children unclip left-to-right), k-floor (rail draws, stops scale in)
motion.purpose: Applied only when html.js is set; content visible without JS. Never combine with Elementor entrance animations.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: durations 0.01ms, delays 0, reveals shown, view-transition animations off, autoplay video paused

narrative.overview:
The site is the shopping complex's directory board, and Kiki's is the strip you came looking for. A brushed-aluminium ground carries deep navy board panels; on them sit enamel sign strips, numbered location plates and one yellow "you are here" state. Everything reads like signage in a Dhaka supermarket stairwell: large, expanded, heavy lettering for the signs, normal-width Anek Bangla for reading, and real numbers (2F, 122, 01680-042538) set as interface.

Density is low and type is large on purpose: body text is 19px, every tap target is at least 48px, and every enclosure does a job (a strip goes somewhere, a plate says where, a tag names a product). Depth is quiet: tonal navy layers separated by 3px seams of a deeper navy, with soft diffuse shadows only on lift. Motion is the board coming alive: strips fill yellow from the left, the yellow plate slides between pages, the floor line draws itself.

The confirmed rejection is the category default: pastel pet templates with rounded icon-card grids, paw confetti and a dog-photo hero.
keyCharacteristics: Navy board panels on a brushed-aluminium ground; yellow is the only state colour.
One family, Anek Bangla, with the width axis carrying the voice (100 reading, 112 to 125 signage).
Enclosures are sign strips, plates and tags, joined by 3px deep-navy seams.
State is a left-to-right fill (strips, buttons, action strip); "you are here" is the strip itself filled yellow.
Bilingual: every section heading carries its Bangla line.
Built for 30+ eyes and thumbs: 19px body, 48px minimum targets, reduced motion honoured.

rules.name: The One State Colour Rule
rules.body: Yellow means "here" or "do this". Nothing decorative is yellow; if a surface is yellow, it is the current location or the action.

rules.name: The Magenta Stays Light Rule
rules.body: Shop magenta appears only on aluminium or white. On navy, use pink-on-navy for brand text and yellow for Bangla sub-lines.

rules.name: The Width Is the Voice Rule
rules.body: Signage (headings, strips, plates, buttons, nav) is set expanded (wdth 112 to 125); reading text and Bangla script stay at wdth 100. Never condense Bangla.

rules.name: The Bilingual Heading Rule
rules.body: Every section H2 carries its Bangla line directly beneath it, set in the Bangla-line style.

rules.name: The Seam Rule
rules.body: Grouped items (strips, steps, address rows, feature rows) are cells in one panel separated by 3px seams of the rail colour, with 9px corners on the outer cells only. They are never separate floating cards.

rules.name: The Flat Until Touched Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat; a shadow appears only with hover lift, or as the mount of a lit panel or the floating dock.

dos: **Do** set every Elementor Global Color from these tokens (Primary board-navy, Secondary shop-magenta, Text ink, Accent here-yellow, plus custom board-strip, board-deep, aluminium, ink-muted) and set all four Global Fonts to Anek Bangla (800 / 700 / 400 / 700).
**Do** keep body text at 19px (18px on small phones) and secondary text at 18px (1.125rem) minimum.
**Do** give every link and control a 48px minimum tap target.
**Do** make state a left-to-right yellow fill; "you are here" is the strip or plate itself filled yellow.
**Do** group related items as seamed cells in one panel (3px seams, 9px outer corners).
**Do** use real numbers (floor, shop number, phone) as large numeral plates.
**Do** pair every section H2 with its Bangla line.
**Do** apply reveals only through the reveal classes, never with Elementor entrance animations on the same element.
donts: **Don't** use pastel pet-template styling: rounded icon-card grids, paw confetti, or a dog-photo hero.
**Don't** add decorative boxes; every enclosure must be a strip, plate, tag or panel that does a job.
**Don't** use yellow for decoration or put shop-magenta on navy.
**Don't** use pill shapes or hard offset shadows.
**Don't** condense Bangla text or set reading text expanded.
